name: Tamsin Reed
greeting: Oi, courier! The river ate my towline. Can you spare a few strands?
lore: The river takes a rope each spring. It has never taken a promise.
accepted: Good. Bring me three strings and I’ll get the ferry moving.
finished: Hear that pulley? The ferry is running again.
objective: Collect and submit three strings for Tamsin’s ferry towline.

name: Puck Thistledown
objective: Submit two moss blocks to soften the trail around the fox burrow.

name: Orin Flint
greeting: Gate watch. Short answers. Torch rack: empty.
lore: First rule: count the lights. Second rule: count again.
accepted: Four torches. Bring them to me at the gate.
objective: Submit four torches for the night watch.

name: Maela Quill
greeting: To the bearer of these words: the flood loosened our oldest register. Will you help bind it before the ink forgets its place?
lore: A penciled note names a street that no longer exists. Someone has drawn its door.
accepted: Three sheets of paper will make a fresh signature. The register can wait no longer.
finished: The names are stitched in. They will outlast another winter.
objective: Submit three paper for the archive’s replacement pages.

name: Brann Coppervein
greeting: Pressure low. Intake full of silt. I can patch the valve if you keep me supplied.
lore: RESULT: one frog, three pebbles, zero useful parts. Frog released.
accepted: Work order logged. Bring three copper ingots to my station.
finished: Valve holds at pressure. Mark the repair closed.
objective: Submit three copper ingots to rebuild the intake valve.

name: Mire-of-Stars
greeting: Last night a star lodged in the marsh. It hummed until dawn. I need a vessel that remembers fire.
lore: It sang the name of someone who had never seen the sky.
accepted: One amethyst shard will remember the sound. Bring it when the water stills.
finished: The light has a home. You may hear it if you hold your breath.
objective: Submit one amethyst shard for Mire’s vessel.

name: Elowen Vale
greeting: Stock check: six hungry apprentices, one empty bread basket, no time to argue about accounting.
lore: Someone paid for lunch with a poem. It was a very expensive poem.
accepted: I’ve recorded a delivery of two loaves. The apprentices are waiting.
finished: Balance settled. I put a little extra aside for you.
objective: Submit two bread for Elowen’s apprentices.

name: Nia Stormglass
greeting: Relay Five to ground crew. Wind tore the weather vane clean off. Do you copy?
lore: Wind from the east, hail by noon, and someone’s hat in low orbit. Over.
accepted: Solid copy. Bring me two iron ingots and I will get the relay back on the air.
finished: Relay Five back online. Good signal. Out.
objective: Submit two iron ingots for a replacement weather vane.

name: Vesper Ink
greeting: Dead drop compromised. The rook stole our seal.
lore: ROOK means actual bird. We are revising the codebook.
accepted: Two ink sacs. Hand them to me here. Tell no one.
objective: Submit two ink sacs to mark Vesper’s replacement documents.
caption: DEAD DROP // INCOMING

name: Sol Emberwake
objective: Submit three charcoal for Sol’s roadside brazier.
caption: Sol Emberwake  /  EMBER OATH

name: Rowan Bell
greeting: Hello there. My bell clapper broke in the storm. Could you help me give the village its morning back?
lore: I do, just before sunrise. My father taught me to leave one beat for the echoes.
accepted: Thank you. Bring me two gold ingots and I will cast a new clapper.
finished: Listen. There it is. Tomorrow, everyone will wake to that sound.
objective: Submit two gold ingots to cast Rowan’s replacement bell clapper.

responses.WAITING: I still need two gold ingots. Bring them here when you have them.
responses.REPORTED: The bell is ringing again. Your reward is in the quest book.
responses.ACTIVE: You already took the job. Bring the gold here when you have it.
responses.UNAVAILABLE: I cannot find the order just now. Give me a moment.
responses.LOCKED: I need you to take the job before I can accept the gold.

name: Sable Fen
greeting: The fog took our beacon. I can still hear the boats. Help me light the channel?
lore: Once the beacon went dark, the fog started calling boats by name.
accepted: Bring me two glass panes. I will fit them into the beacon.
finished: There. A light on the water. The boats can find their way home.
objective: Submit two glass panes to replace the lens of Sable's fog beacon.

responses.WAITING: The beacon still needs two panes. Bring them to me when you find them.
responses.REPORTED: The channel is lit. Your reward is in the quest book.
responses.ACTIVE: You already took the job. Bring the panes to me when you have them.
responses.UNAVAILABLE: The fog has swallowed the work order. Try again in a moment.
responses.LOCKED: Take the beacon job first. Then I can accept the glass.

caption: BEACON KEEPER
